Mandal Family (Malakhera, Alwar)
The Mandal family is one of the well-known and socially influential families based in Malakhera, a town in Alwar district, Rajasthan, India. Recognized for their extensive family lineage, government service, and growing political engagement, the family holds a significant presence in the region.
---
🧬 Family Background
The Mandal family of Malakhera traces its roots back several generations in Alwar. Known for its unity and size, the family comprises more than 100 members living across Malakhera and nearby towns. They are respected locally for their contribution to civil services and social harmony in the region.
---
🛡️ Public Service and Government Jobs
Over 30 members of the Mandal family are currently serving or have served in government jobs, particularly in the Rajasthan Police Department, administrative roles, and local panchayat offices. Their consistent involvement in public service has built a reputation of discipline and responsibility.
---
🏛️ Political Involvement
The Mandal family has had active involvement in local and regional politics, participating in panchayat elections, social movements, and youth representation. Some members of the family are associated with mainstream political parties in Rajasthan, often contributing to election campaigns and grassroots political mobilization in the Alwar district.
---
📍 Location: Malakhera, Alwar
Malakhera is a town and tehsil in the Alwar district of Rajasthan. The Mandal family has long-standing roots in this area, contributing to its socio-political growth. The family's home is considered a hub for social gatherings and cultural celebrations.
---
📰 Media & Recognition
While there is no formal national media coverage yet, the family is locally regarded as one of the “strongest and most active households” in Malakhera for their size, social discipline, and public presence.
